items.title: Centre Wellington Hydro Annual General Meeting
notes: Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer

W. Dyce, President, CW Hydro gave a presentation reviewing the company structure, Centre Wellington Hydro performance & rates, capital project investment, customer engagement, and a review of the financials.

items.title: Erika Montero – Current Chair, Elora BIA re: item 12.2 BIA Board
notes: Composition expressed concerns about a lack of transparency within the BIA and Township processes. She noted that a clerical error has persisted in the by-law for 15 years. Additional concerns included improper financial management, lack of communication, and staff appointing themselves to the interim board without adequate consultation.

Catherine Daultrey – Member, Elora BIA & Business Owner re: item 12.2 BIA Board Composition spoke to the Board’s efforts to align BIA operations with open meeting requirements and legal compliance. She highlighted a procedural correction in progress and referenced the outdated by-law, noting that council has appointed more than three members for over a decade. A general election has been called four times since January to address gaps left by the previous Board. She raised concerns about unauthorized spending and urged council to allow the Board to continue their work transparently.

Cathi Bastien – Elora BIA Board Member & Business Owner re: item 12.2 BIA Board Composition argued that the recommendation to enforce an outdated by-law is unnecessary, as the business environment has significantly changed since its adoption. She emphasized that the current Board passed a resolution requesting council to update the by- law. She raised concerns about the financial and reputational cost of the current process, stressed her commitment to supporting a future board, and urged council to reject the recommendation for staff-led Interim Board oversight.

Kathy Sullivan – Member, Elora BIA & Business Owner re: item 12.2 BIA Board Composition described a meeting with Township staff in January and emphasized her support for a collaborative, forward-looking approach. She stated the board acted in good faith with Township guidance and has since voted to reduce its numbers by two members to return to compliance. She believes the current Board is willing to cooperate and that an Interim Board is unnecessary.

items.title: Darcy Saunders, Elora resident re: item 12.2 BIA Board Composition
notes: shared concerns regarding by-law inconsistencies and enforcement, citing past construction projects that proceeded without permits. He questioned the allocation of Township staff resources to dissolving a volunteer-led BIA board. He noted that replacing local volunteers with high-level Township staff raises concerns with transparency and governance. He urged Council to reflect on the precedent being set.

items.title: BIA Board Composition Update
notes: Report from D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer

D. Wilson, Chief Administrative Officer provided an overview of the report and responded to questions and comments related to the timing of the proposed Elora BIA General Meeting. He explained the Township Solicitor has recently advised the original by-law establishing the Elora Business Improvement Area (BIA) indicates the membership on the Board shall consist of four (4) members appointed by Council, one (1) of whom shall be a member of Council. The Township has appointed, in error, more Elora BIA Board of Management Members than actual existing Board positions allowable under the establishing by-law.
Councillor Adams proposed an amendment to the staff recommendation to remove Councillor Jefferson and add Mayor Watters to the Interim Board.
Councillor Wilton agreed to second the amendment.
D. Wilson responded to questions regarding the timing to undertake a similar process for the Fergus BIA and the ability of the current Board members to put their names forward for re-election.
Mayor Watters called for a lunch recess. The meeting resumed at 1:00 pm.

items.title: Belwood Hall Renovation

Michael Bilijentiaj from ATA Architects Inc. gave a presentation reviewing the project team. He outlined the scope of work involved at each phase of the project, the revised project schedule and cost estimates.
